patchwork_fixes.configuration.title: Patchwork
patchwork_fixes.modscreen.title: Patchwork fixes for %s
patchwork_fixes.modscreen.hint: Hover a switch for what it does. The same switches are under Mods > Patchwork.
patchwork_fixes.modscreen.restart: Saved. Restart the game for the change to take effect.
patchwork_fixes.modscreen.version: Not running: you have version %s, this fix is for %s.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.modules.to: Each module fixes one mod and only runs if that mod is installed at a version it was written for.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.biolith.to: Biolith (bundled in Quark and others): biome lookups during world generation stop creating new objects every call. Same biomes.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.terrablend: TerraBlender: no throwaway function per surface block during world generation. Same terrain.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.terrainsla: Terrain Slabs: scans each column once instead of 3 block reads and 3 new objects per block. Same slabs.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.voicelesss: Voiceless Survival: mob memory leak fix
Voiceless Survival kept every mob that ever spawned in memory for the whole session. This frees them when they leave the world.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.essential: Essential: No Cost While Cosmetics Are Off
While cosmetics are switched off in the Wardrobe, Essential's cosmetics drawing is skipped entirely, so it costs no performance.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.essentialw: Adds one On/Off switch at the top of the Wardrobe for all emotes and cosmetics. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.essentiala: Removes the Enable Essential switch from Essential's settings. Turning it off could only be undone by editing its config. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.modernfixb: ModernFix's surface-rule speed-up reads each section's biome list directly instead of copying every cell. Same terrain, less garbage while chunks generate.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.sdlsources: Keeps dynamic light sources in a list rebuilt only when lights come or go, read without waiting on a lock. Lights appearing or disappearing no longer stall the game while chunks are built. Same light.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.vbleafcolo: Works out leaf litter colour directly instead of building and discarding a tint cache for every block. Same colours, less garbage while chunks are drawn.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.earlyconfi: Stops crashes during loading when a mod checks its settings every tick before they have loaded. Its tick is skipped until they are ready.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.vbconfigti: Stops a crash during loading when Vanilla Backport checks its settings before they have loaded. It waits until they are ready.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.essentialu: Stops Essential's update toast and changelog window on the menus. A required update is still shown, and you can update by hand from Essential's menu.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.eatinganim: Eating and drinking animations without Groovy ModLoader (about 100 MB less memory). Off automatically while the original Eating Animation mod is installed.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.subtleeffe: Subtle Effects re-checks the biome, its config conditions and long block lists for every animated block, every tick. This works each answer out once per tick and reuses it. The effects look exactly the same. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.accelerate: With a shader pack on, Accelerated Rendering's forced translucent batching shows the sky through player and piglin heads. This sends only those translucent models through the normal path while shaders draw the world; everything else stays accelerated. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.watut: What Are They Up To: Live GUI Preview
patchwork_fixes.configuration.watut.tool: Makes the floating preview of another player's open menu update live and look sharper, removes its flicker, and only sends the pixels that changed. Also fixes crashes from bad preview packets and frees memory when players leave. Every player needs Patchwork for the live preview. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.supplement: With Quark installed, using the wrench on a block that has no item (like the side of hanging cave vines) crashed the game. Those blocks are now skipped by the wood check. Everything else rotates as before. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.campfirere: Campfire Resting sent every player's rest data to everyone in the dimension, and clients that did not have that player loaded threw an error each time (tens of thousands per session). Updates now go only to players who can see that player. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.nomadicten: Right-clicking a tent door with a mallet often teleported you inside instead of packing the tent up, because the mod checked the wrong hand. The door now uses the hand you clicked with, and holding a mallet stops the walk-in teleport. Needs a restart.
patchwork.version_changed.title: Patchwork
patchwork.version_changed.body.one: %s updated, so its fix is off for now. The game works normally.
patchwork.version_changed.body.many: %s updated, so their fixes are off for now. The game works normally.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.streamsref: Streams Reflowing: No Stall Dump Files
Streams Reflowing writes a thread dump to disk whenever chunk generation stalls. This turns on the mod's own switch to stop those files. River generation is unchanged. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.midnightli: Mods that use MidnightLib (like Smooth Steps) could crash the game at startup when two of them loaded their settings at the same moment. This makes them take turns. Settings are unchanged. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.iris.toolt: Some shader packs (like Bliss) keep data in images they never clear. Iris created those images with leftover video memory, which showed up as a strong yellow-green glow near you at sunset and night. This starts them empty. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.irisshader: Each time the game starts, Iris rewrites every program of your shader pack before it can show it, which takes a second or more. This keeps the rewritten programs on disk (at most 64 MB) and reuses them only when the pack, its settings, your mods and your graphics driver are exactly the same. Same shaders. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.afkcinema: Absolute AFK Cinema: Always Restore HUD
After the AFK camera had played once, later runs could end without bringing the hotbar and HUD back (they stayed hidden until F1). Now every run restores them. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.immersivep: Immersive Portals: Load My Chunks Compatibility
Immersive Portals and Load My Chunks both changed the same check that lets empty dimensions sleep, which crashed the game at start. Now both rules apply together. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.stutterfix: StutterFix crashed the game at start if another mod used the background worker threads before all mods had loaded (Immersive Portals does). Now it checks the mod list a way that works that early. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.c2mechunkf: C2ME built a new answer object every time a mod asked whether a chunk was ready to tick. Mods that ask about every chunk every tick made that a big source of memory churn. Now the same answer is reused while the chunk is the same. Needs a restart.
JEI's color search made a new 128 KB scratch table for every item it looked at. Now each thread reuses one. Same colors. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.quarkposts: Wood posts copied the list of directions every time the game asked for their shape. Now they share one copy. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.clienttwea: Client Tweaks looked at your held item for every block's shape, even blocks that aren't chains or panes. Now it checks the block first. Same shapes. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.ambientsou: The ambient sound scanner copied the list of directions at every step. Now it shares one copy. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.stormiespi: Stormie's Spiders: One Scan Per Tick

Every spider looked at the blocks around it six times a tick to decide which side to walk on, making a lot of garbage memory with many spiders around. Now it looks once and works out the same answer. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.soundwatch: If Minecraft's sound thread crashes (for example when memory runs out) or stops answering, the game used to freeze the next time a sound played. Now that sound is skipped and the sound thread is restarted. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.lithiumnbt: Lithium gave every NBT tag a map sized for 16 entries, though most hold only a few. Saving and loading chunks made about a fifth of all the game's garbage this way. Now tags start small and grow when needed. Same data. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.irispathch: Iris allows capital letters in resource names by hooking a check that runs for every letter of every name, creating a small object each time. Now the same check runs without that. Same names allowed. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.cinematicr: Cinematic Respawn: Back to Death Screen

Screens opened from the death screen, like the Spawnstones waystone picker, could not go back to it: Cancel did nothing and you were stuck. Now they return to the death screen as expected. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.flywheelno: Create's renderer woke all of its worker threads for every task, and the game's render thread then had to wait for them to settle, causing short hitches. Now one worker is woken per task, without that wait. Same rendering. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.puzzleshol: Mods built on Puzzles Lib wrote out an error message every time they looked up their settings, just in case the lookup failed. Easy Anvils does this for every block placed in world generation. Now the message is only written when something is actually wrong. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.c2meunload: When chunks unload, C2ME re-marked steps that were already marked unloaded, creating garbage each time. Now it skips them. Same chunk loading. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.modlistrec: Adds a Recent button next to Off / A-Z / Z-A in the mod list. It lists the mods you last clicked or opened the settings of first, then the rest A-Z. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.modlist.recent.tooltip: Mods you clicked or configured most recently first
patchwork_fixes.configuration.colorwheel: Colorwheel: Fallback for Any Shader Pack

With a shader pack Colorwheel has no support for, Create shafts, cogs and contraptions are drawn through the pack's own shaders, so they keep their colours and cast shadows. Packs with a Colorwheel version still use it. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.obeemf: Optimized Block Entities: EMF Model Shapes
patchwork_fixes.configuration.obeemf.too: With Entity Model Features installed, Optimized Block Entities drew chests and similar blocks half a block off and sunk into the floor (a flat square on the ground). Blocks with an EMF custom model are drawn the normal way instead, the way EMF intends. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.colorwheel: Colorwheel shows a red chat alert each time you use a shader pack it has no support for. This hides it. The alert still shows when a Colorwheel version of your pack is available to pick instead. Turn this off to get every alert back. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.fabricattr: Fabric Mob Attributes: Start-up Crash Fix

Stops a start-up crash when Fabric mods like Better Nether or Better End are installed with NeoForge mods like Atmospheric. Their mob attributes are set a moment later, when NeoForge is ready. Same mobs. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.atlasbiome: Antique Atlas: Textures for Every Biome
Biomes the atlas does not recognise (caves, many modded biomes) are drawn with a texture that fits their climate instead of left blank. Savanna biomes get their savanna texture. Needs a restart.
Better Nether's extra piglin barters (blue and weeping obsidian) were never added because of a bug in BCLib. This adds them. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.clipnan.to: Stops the game freezing when a mod traces where a player is looking and that player's view is broken. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.lootmissin: When a chest or block loot list names an item from a mod you don't have, only that item is skipped. Before, the whole list failed and the chest stayed empty. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.relativebl: Olaf's Relatively Placed Blocks: NeoForge Support

Lets the mod start on NeoForge at all. Small blocks that share one block space are drawn (they were invisible), and mining one plays the sound of the small block you are aiming at, as the mod does on Fabric. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.particlera: Particle Rain looked up each particle's texture name from scratch for every rain, snow and dust particle. Now each name is looked up once and reused. Same particles, less garbage. Needs a restart.
Effortless Building sends a welcome chat message (hold Left Alt...) the first time you join each world. This hides it. Turn this off to get the message back.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.nbtstrings: Every loaded chunk repeats the same key names and block names hundreds of times, and each was read into a new copy. Now each is read into one shared copy. Less garbage while chunks load. Same data. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.dungeonspr: The first-join question ran off both edges of large screens. It now wraps to fit. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.ebalttab: Effortless Building: Alt+Tab Keeps Build Mode
patchwork_fixes.configuration.ebalttab.t: Alt+Tab used to switch your build mode to whatever the mouse was over on the build wheel. Tab or leaving the game now cancels the wheel and keeps your mode. The wheel also dims the world far less. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.leafpathin: Traversable Leaves: Mobs Path Through Leaves
Mobs could walk through leaves but still planned around them as walls, so one caught in leaves spun on the spot. They now plan through leaves (a little slower than open ground). Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.slabbedlea: Both mods change how blocks collide at the same spot, so the game crashed on entering a world. Patchwork does both jobs in one place: walk-through leaves and lowered slab blocks both work. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.soundphysi: Sound Physics: No Errors On Join
Right after joining a world, Sound Physics threw errors and dropped sounds until its world copy was ready. Those sounds now play plainly for that moment. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.carryonren: Carried blocks and mobs showed through walls, and with shader packs they turned see-through or vanished. Now they are drawn like any other model, solid and at their normal size. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.fastnbtnam: FastNBT parsed the block name of every saved block type again each time a chunk loaded. Now each name is parsed once and reused. Less garbage while chunks load. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.cullreset: Entity Culling: Clear Only Used Cache
Entity Culling wiped its whole 4 MB cache before every culling pass. Now it clears only the parts the last pass used. Same culling, less CPU. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.c2metickin: C2ME: No Waiting on Ticking Checks

Mods that check every loaded chunk every tick had to wait whenever C2ME was busy with that chunk, causing short server stalls. Now the check reads the answer without waiting. Same answers. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.emfdefer: Entity Model Features: Smoother Loading Screen
patchwork_fixes.configuration.emfdefer.t: Entity Model Features set up every mob animation while the Mojang logo was showing, freezing it for over a second. Now that work runs in small pieces right after the loading screen, and always finishes before any mob is drawn. Same animations. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.irisnameta: With a shader pack, player and mob name tags cast a shadow floating in the air. This leaves name tags out of the shadow, which also makes shadows a little faster. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.signtext.t: Text on signs farther away than the distance below is too small to read, but drawing it still costs a lot with many signs around. Past that distance only the sign is drawn; looking through a spyglass still shows the text. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.stoneholmM: A Stoneholm underground village stops growing at this many pieces.
A Stoneholm underground village stops growing after this much layout time, so world generation never stalls.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.signTextDi: How far away (in blocks) sign text is still drawn. Used by the sign text fix above.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.rendertype: With a shader pack, banners ask for the same long name of each pattern layer every frame, and the game rebuilt it every time. Now it is built once. Looks the same, banners draw faster. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.seamlesslo: Seamless Loading Screen: Fix Crash on Leaving

Seamless Loading Screen only learned a world's name when you opened it from the world list. Worlds opened another way (for example by an auto-start mod) crashed the game when you left them. Now every world gets its name, so leaving works and its loading screenshot is saved. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.loadmychun: Load My Chunks: Fix Freeze and Exit Hang

Load My Chunks could get stuck in an endless loop when chunks loaded while it was ticking entities, freezing the world and making the game hang when you quit. This makes it work from a snapshot of the loaded chunks. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.nestedjars: Many mods bundle other jars inside themselves, and the mod loader keeps every one of those whole in memory for the entire session. This saves each one once to cache/patchwork/nested-jars and reads it from there instead, freeing that memory. Same files, nothing else changes. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.villagerap: Villager API: Scan Packs Once Per World

Villager API looked for its villager packs again, across every mod, for each step of starting a world. This keeps the first result until the world closes, so worlds open about a second faster. Packs added while a world is open show up the next time you open it. Needs a restart.
patchwork_fixes.configuration.skinlayers: 3D Skin Layers: Skip in Shader Shadows

With a shader pack on, 3D Skin Layers drew every player's 3D outer layer a second time just for the shadow. The shadow now uses the flat outer layer instead, for about 10% more FPS. Players and their shadow outlines look the same. Needs a restart.
